items.prompt:
In nuclear fission, a large nucleus
A) splits into smaller nuclei
B) joins with another
C) stays the same
D) turns into light only

In nuclear fusion, small nuclei
A) join into a larger nucleus
B) split apart
C) disappear
D) freeze
items.answer: A) join into a larger nucleus

items.prompt:
What process powers the Sun?
A) Fusion
B) Fission
C) Burning wood
D) Erosion

steps: The Sun is powered by fusion.

items.prompt:
Radioactive decay is when an unstable nucleus
A) gives off particles or energy and changes into a different nucleus
B) stays exactly the same forever
C) gains mass from nothing
D) turns into a chemical
items.answer: A) gives off particles or energy and changes into a different nucleus

items.prompt:
Compared with chemical reactions, nuclear processes release
A) far more energy
B) far less energy
C) the same energy
D) no energy

Which process JOINS nuclei?
A) Fusion
B) Fission
C) Decay
D) Burning

steps: Fusion joins nuclei; fission splits them.

items.prompt:
A nucleus emits a particle and becomes a new element. This is
A) radioactive decay
B) fission
C) fusion
D) a chemical reaction

steps: Decay changes the nucleus into a new one.

items.prompt:
Fission and fusion differ because
A) fission splits a large nucleus while fusion joins small nuclei
B) both split nuclei
C) both join nuclei
D) neither changes the nucleus
items.answer: A) fission splits a large nucleus while fusion joins small nuclei

steps: They change nuclei in opposite ways.
